script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: THE UNSUNG HEROES

FADE IN:

EXT. SUBURBAN NEIGHBORHOOD - DAY

A beautiful, sunlit day in the suburbs. Birds chirping, children playing, and the gentle hum of lawnmowers fill the air.

INT. MCKENNA LIVING ROOM - DAY

SARA MCKENNA (30s, a bit clumsy and socially awkward but with a warm and earnest disposition) sits on the couch, surrounded by books. Her cat, WHISKERS, sleeps on her lap.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Sara McKenna: Librarian, cat lady, and the unsung hero of our quaint suburban town.

The doorbell rings. Sara stands and walks to the door, looking out through the peephole.

SARA
(whispering)
Who could it be?

INT. ENTRANCEWAY - DAY

Sara opens the door to reveal CHRIS THOMAS (30s, a charming, charismatic, and outgoing neighbor). He carries a basket of fresh fruit.

CHRIS
Hey, Sara! I saw the lights were on, and I figured you might be in need of some fresh produce.

SARA
Oh, Chris! You're a lifesaver. Thank you so much!

INT. MCKENNA KITCHEN - DAY

Chris helps Sara sort through the fruit.

CHRIS
You know, Sara, you really should let me help you out more often. I could mow your lawn, or even help you with that pesky storm drain.

SARA
(smiling)
Well, I appreciate the offer, but I prefer to do things myself. Plus, I enjoy the peace and quiet of my little suburban life.

CHRIS
Fair enough, but if you ever change your mind...

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

Sara arrives at the library, where she works. MRS. FISHER (60s, a wise and nurturing librarian) greets her with a warm smile.

MRS. FISHER
Ah, Sara, I've got just the thing for you. Our new book donation has arrived, and I know you'll love it.

INT. LIBRARY - STACK ROOM - DAY

Sara and Chris explore the new shipment. They reminisce about old books and share their favorite childhood memories.

SARA
(grinning)
You know, Chris, I think we're the only two people in this town who appreciate the true beauty of a good book.

CHRIS
Absolutely! And who knows? Maybe we'll start a book club, or even a community reading room.

INT. MCKENNA LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Sara sits in her armchair, reading a new book she discovered at the library. She dozes off, Whiskers curled up next to her.

INT. SUBURBAN PARK - DAY

Sara and Chris, accompanied by their neighbors, gather at the park for a community picnic. They share stories, laughter, and newfound connections.

CHRIS
(raising his glass)
To friendship and the power of a good book.

ALL
Cheers!

INT. MCKENNA LIVING ROOM - EVENING

Sara looks around her cozy home, filled with warmth and love from her newfound friends. She realizes that being an unsung hero isn't about doing things alone; it's about sharing experiences and cherishing the connections we make with others.

SARA
(whispering to Whiskers)
We're not alone in this world, after all.

FADE OUT.

THE END
